hmy.review:
HMY sir is good, but you need to be able to keep up with him. He gives a really big syllabus, even for quizzes, and his definition of a short question is like one page long, so a BQ can easily be three pages. You also need to interact a lot in class, and he does take a viva (which wasn’t really that hard).
There’s also a presentation, and he appreciates formats that are different from the standard “looking at slides and talking” approach. We did ours in a talk-show format, and doing something creative like that can get you higher marks.
You have to slowly adjust to his tactics and requirements, as they’re a little different from those of the usual faculty members. Overall, he’s good, but he doesn’t curve at all, and it might be too much pressure for a GED course if you just want an easy A.
Hmy is the best faculty anyone can ever have .
